ValidationRule.description: For SAP NA and Germany billing citymust be 35 characters long or less.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias<> "sconn",
OR( AND( LEN(BillingCity) > 35, OR( RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA" ) ),
AND( LEN(BillingCity) > 20, RecordType.Name = "QAD - LDGI" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: City for SAP sites must be 35 characters or less.
